payload.text: I found 2 genes and 5 conditions related to MLH1, MSH2 and colorectal cancer [3][4][5][6][7][8][9].
The protein partners with another repair protein called PMS2 to form a complex called MutL alpha, which is part of the DNA mismatch repair system [1].
When this complex finds a spelling mistake in DNA, it helps create a break in the DNA strand so the error can be cut out and corrected [1].
This gene was found to be often mutated in a hereditary form of colon cancer [1].
One study found that disrupting key interaction points in MLH1 can cause a failure of mismatch repair [2].

The protein partners with another repair protein called PMS2 to form a complex called MutL alpha, which is part of the DNA mismatch repair system [1]. This gene was found to be often mutated in a hereditary form of colon cancer [1]. 

One study found that disrupting key interaction points in MLH1 can cause a failure of mismatch repair [2].
